verified_behavior: The Metal view frame matches all four full-window edges, including the visible system status bar.
Movement controls remain above the home-indicator safe area; panel anchors use full-canvas projection coordinates.
Touch drag changes yaw; motion mode accepts a synthetic native quaternion and ignores right-side drag.

Switching back to touch resumes right-side camera drag.
Without the explicit fixture on the simulator, motion is unavailable and touch continues working.
